notes: Small-balance tuned preset (active 2026-09-10). With ~$10-20 USD of BCH, every position has to be small enough that slippage+fees don't eat the trade. max_position_bch=0.005 keeps each trade at ~10-12% of wallet. Scale these values up ONLY after a 7-day live run with positive P&L.

scoring._min_trade_count_24h_comment: T44: staleness gate — reject any token the indexer reports as having zero trades in the current 24h window. Defends against phantom-price entries (QBTC had trade_count=0, price_now_sats=32.7B). Set to 0 to disable.
scoring._min_fee_yield_bps_comment: T75: synthesized LP-fee-yield floor. Drops pools whose fee_yield_bps (trade_count × fee_rate_bps / max(tvl_sats, 1)) is below this minimum. Defense-in-depth on top of min_trade_count_24h — catches pools that have trades but aren't generating meaningful LP fee income relative to their TVL. Set to 0 to disable.
scoring._adaptive_weights_comment: T56-2 — auto-tune scoring.weights from the last `adaptive_weights_window_days` of closed trades. Disabled by default; flip `scoring.adaptive_weights_enabled=true` to opt in. Every applied weight-set is written to `config/user.json` (deep-merge — WIF/mnemonic untouched) AND stamped into `data/adaptive-weights.jsonl` for audit. Hot-read every tick; no restart needed.
scoring._concentration_comment: T76 subset 1 — operator-curated blacklist of token_ids the loop should drop pre-entry on the rug-concentration rationale. The actual automated detection (scanning the chain for the top-N holders + comparing to the threshold) is deferred to T76 subset 2: today neither the Cauldron indexer nor the standard Electrum providers surface a token-holders endpoint, so an in-process scanner is required (chain-state fetch + per-UTXO CashTokens FT output aggregation). This subset ships the math + the operator's manually-maintained list. Format: array of 64-char lowercase hex token_ids. The same lowercased-membership semantics as `excluded_tokens` apply. Default empty.
scoring._concentration_rug_enabled_comment: T76 subset 2a — opt-in switch for the live holders scanner on the dashboard endpoint. Default false (subset 1 stub behavior preserved) so operators who haven't audited the upstream don't accidentally start broadcasting their token_ids to a third party. Flip to true to enable the live wire-up at `/api/token/<id>/holders`; the existing stub envelope stays in place for operators who leave it OFF. Hot-read every request (no restart needed).
scoring._concentration_rug_provider_url_comment: T76 subset 2a — override for the TokenStork upstream URL. Defaults to `https://tokenstork.com` (the only public BCH FT-UTXO holders endpoint discovered on 2026-09-20). Operators who mirror the upstream behind a corp proxy / cache can set this without a code change. Restart:false (hot-read).
scoring._concentration_rug_timeout_ms_comment: T76 subset 2a — per-request timeout (ms) for the upstream fetch. Default 5000 (the upstream typically responds in <1s). Clamped at 60000 by `clampHoldersScannerCacheMs`-style helper so a typo'd knob can't hang a tick. Restart:false (hot-read).
scoring._concentration_rug_cache_ms_comment: T76 subset 2a — per-token TTL cache window (ms) for the holders scanner. Default 300000 (5 minutes). Set to 0 to disable caching (every dashboard poll re-fetches the upstream). Clamped at 3600000 (1h) so a typo can't disable the cache for a day. Restart:false (hot-read).

entry._slippage_cap_per_token_comment: T55: per-token slippage cap derived from AMM pool depth. The flat slippage_tolerance_bps is replaced by a depth-aware cap when poolDepthSats is available: cap = clamp(est_constant_product_slippage_bps * multiplier, slippage_cap_min_bps, slippage_cap_max_bps). Deep pools get a tighter cap (protection); shallow pools get a looser cap (legitimate trades don't get rejected). Set slippage_cap_per_token_enabled=false to restore the v1 flat-cap behavior.

risk._dust_position_auto_close_comment: T87: dust-position auto-close. When ON, at the end of every trader-loop tick the bot evaluates every open position against the close-cost test (tx fee + slippage × budget_multiplier). Positions whose projected market value is below that threshold are auto-closed via the same Positions.close() API (bch_received_sats:0, reason:'dust_position_auto_close') so the dashboard / P&L rollups see the synthetic close immediately. Operator-set `exit_overrides.prevent_stop_loss:true` overrides the dust gate (hold until profit always wins). Default OFF — opt-in for safety. Hot-read every tick (`restart:false`).

staking._comment: T75 (BadgerCoin staking live wire, 2026-09-19) — single-position auto-lock that uses half of the wallet's available BCH (operator-approved at 2026-09-19 22:58 PDT). Three operator-facing knobs must all be true for the auto-lock path to fire: `enabled`, `simulation_only:false`, `auto_lock_enabled`. The unlock counterpart is `auto_unlock_enabled`. `max_active_stakes:1` is a hard invariant (also enforced by the `STALE_LOCK_EXISTS` guard inside `executeLock`). The `allow_when_positions_open` knob is kept for backward-compat but is IGNORED by the live wire — open trading positions no longer factor into the BadgerStake decision (per operator spec). `lock_amount_sats` is also kept for backward-compat but IGNORED — the loop computes `lock_amount_sats = wallet_balance / 2` on every tick. The reserve floor `lock_min_balance_bch` still gates the attempt (refuses to lock if it would leave the wallet below this floor).

alerts._comment: T53.1 — alerts subsystem foundation. Disabled by default so dispatch() is a true noop until the operator opts in. T53.2 wires the trader loop's dispatch points; T53.3 (future) adds per-decision-point dispatches. T59 subset 1 adds `orphan_position_check_enabled` so the manual CLI can suppress the orphan-position alert without disabling the whole subsystem. T59 subset 2 auto-wires the check into `src/trader/loop.mjs` (step 9 of `_runTick`) and hot-reads this flag every tick — the operator can flip `orphan_position_check_enabled` to `false` without a restart to disable the per-tick self-check (the manual CLI keeps working). T62 adds `orphan_auto_reconcile_enabled` (default false so a fresh install can never silently close positions) + `orphan_auto_reconcile_min_age_minutes` (default 60 so a UTXO-scan race can't close a freshly-detected orphan). T62 auto-wires step 9.5 of `_runTick` and hot-reads both flags every tick.

telegram._comment: T53.1 — Bot API token. NEVER set this in config/default.json — load from config/user.json (gitignored, chmod 600). The router only sends when `alerts.enabled === true` AND `alerts.channels` contains 'telegram' AND both `telegram.bot_token` and `alerts.telegram_chat_id` are populated.
